prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one standalone game enemy sprite: a small original block-built toy DINOSAUR BOSS.
Reference image: simple red cube monster for bold outline and flat-color style ONLY. Build a NEW compact squat dinosaur from chunky rounded rectangular blocks. Teal green head/body/legs, coral-red broad nose cap and 3 dorsal plates, small blunt yellow teeth. Four short sturdy legs, very short thick tail, tiny deadpan black eyes. Mouth open a little. The whole dinosaur forms one connected piece.
Camera: orthographic overhead 3/4 view with top clearly visible, nose facing bottom-right.
Crucial presentation: a SIMPLE FLAT INK DRAWING, only hard-edged solid flat color planes within a thick black ink silhouette. No illumination or lighting effects of any kind. No light emission. No ambient aura. No haze. No halo. No shadows, including drop shadow or colored edge shadow. No glow or gradients. No blurred pixels outside the ink silhouette. Exterior must be completely empty transparent alpha, not tinted. No scene, floor, UI, text, detached debris, equipment, cannon or guns.
Composition: landscape canvas, entire dinosaur centered and occupies only the middle 65% of canvas width and middle 65% of canvas height. Large empty transparent border on ALL FOUR sides, at least 15% each. Tail and every foot entirely inside frame. Cute chunky paper-sticker style but no white sticker outline, nothing behind or under the dinosaur.
Keep the design simple, about twelve chunky blocks total. Clean outline. TRUE transparent background.
